pairs.subject: credential-vault
pairs.evidence: src/lib/inventory/token-crypto.ts:98 The vault exposes plaintext credential values directly to callers via decryptToken instead of brokering egress, lacks AAD record binding and envelope encryption in token-crypto, and collapses health probing into a binary failure without live admission validation.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/inventory/token-crypto.ts:89 Ciphertext is not bound to record identity via authenticated associated data (AAD), and keys are derived directly from a server secret without a master key envelope.
src/lib/inventory/token-crypto.ts:98 Plaintext credentials are decrypted and returned directly to callers instead of brokering calls through a single egress door where callers submit intent.

src/lib/inventory/connection-store.ts:11 StoredConnection omits provenance tracking for credential acquisition mode, and tokens are stored without live validation probes against the provider before admission.
src/lib/inventory/warehouse.ts:83 Health status collapses transient network or provider errors into failing rather than separating them into an unknown state from broken credentials.
src/lib/inventory/token-crypto.ts:40 The vault lacks an overlap window or planned rotation mechanism for keys; changing server secrets invalidates all stored tokens and requires manual re-entry.
src/lib/inventory/token-crypto.ts:3 Warehouse tokens are non-expiring API tokens without an issuer expiry clock or grant/proof refresh lifecycle.

pairs.subject: credential-vault
pairs.evidence: src/components/app/modules/ByomKeys.tsx:374 The UI displays key suffix characters rather than confirming purely by identity, and provides an unguided paste field lacking provider deep-links and scope instructions.

techniques.evidence: src/components/app/modules/ByomKeys.tsx:374 The UI partially echoes credential values by displaying the last 4 characters rather than confirming purely by identity.
src/components/app/modules/ByomKeys.tsx:328 The UI checks and renders verification staleness explicitly rather than displaying a stale verification as current health.
src/components/app/modules/ByomKeys.tsx:502 The UI distinguishes definitive faults that bench a key from transient failures that safely fall back to the app provider.

pairs.subject: credential-vault
pairs.evidence: src/lib/google/token.ts:74 The platform integration dispenses raw plaintext bearer tokens to callers via getUserAccessToken, stores OAuth tokens unencrypted in Firestore, and lacks scheduled single-flight refresh lifecycle management.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/google/token.ts:83 Token refresh evaluates a fixed 60-second window only lazily on caller demand, lacks a background cadence, has no single-flight mutex against stampedes, and fails without error classification.
src/lib/google/token.ts:90 Google OAuth access and refresh tokens are stored in plaintext in the Firestore accounts collection without envelope encryption.
src/lib/google/token.ts:74 The module returns the raw plaintext bearer token directly to external callers rather than brokering calls through an internal authenticated gateway.
src/lib/google/token.ts:85 Token refreshes are not managed by an active two-thirds renewal loop with jittered grace and look-ahead exit, relying solely on caller-triggered checks.
src/lib/google/ads.ts:56 API errors are classified into binary retry vs degradation with no graduated remediation ladder (observe -> warn -> degrade -> suspend) and no credential rotation overlap.
